description: Curated contradiction-detection eval set. 30 positive (contradiction) and 20 negative (paraphrase/complementary/unrelated) scenarios. Used by evaluations/run_contradiction_eval.py.

page_a.title: Payments API Overview
page_a.text: The Payments API is currently on version 2.0. All new integrations must target v2.0 endpoints at /api/v2/payments.

page_b.title: Payments Integration Guide
page_b.text: Integrations should use Payments API version 3.0. The v3 endpoints at /api/v3/payments are the only supported path for new work.

page_a.title: Auth Service README
page_a.text: OAuth tokens issued by the auth service expire after 24 hours and must be refreshed daily.

page_b.title: Security Standards
page_b.text: Access tokens are short-lived: they expire after 15 minutes. Long-lived 24-hour tokens were disabled in Q2.

page_a.title: Webhooks Guide
page_a.text: Webhook payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA1. Verify the X-Signature header using SHA1.

page_b.title: Webhook Security
page_b.text: All webhook payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256. SHA1 signatures were removed and are no longer sent.

page_a.title: Rate Limits
page_a.text: The public API allows 100 requests per minute per API key.

page_b.title: API Quotas and Limits
page_b.text: Every API key is limited to 1,000 requests per minute. The old 100 rpm cap was raised last year.

page_a.title: SDK Support Matrix
page_a.text: The official SDK supports Python 3.8 and newer. Python 2 support ended in 2020.

page_b.title: Getting Started with the SDK
page_b.text: The SDK requires Python 3.11 or newer; versions below 3.11 are unsupported and will fail at install time.

page_a.title: Leave Policy
page_a.text: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave per year, accrued monthly.

page_b.title: Employee Handbook - Time Off
page_b.text: All full-time employees are entitled to 25 days of annual leave each calendar year.

page_a.title: Remote Work Policy
page_a.text: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval.

page_b.title: Ways of Working
page_b.text: We are a remote-first company: employees may work remotely full-time without needing approval.

page_a.title: Probation Guidelines
page_a.text: The probation period for new hires is 3 months, after which a review is conducted.

page_b.title: Onboarding FAQ
page_b.text: New starters have a 6-month probation period ending with a formal performance review.

page_a.title: Expense Policy
page_a.text: Meal expenses while travelling are reimbursed up to $50 per day.

page_b.title: Travel and Expenses
page_b.text: The daily meal allowance for business travel is $100; claims above this need CFO approval.

page_a.title: Parental Leave
page_a.text: Primary carers are entitled to 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

page_b.title: Benefits Summary
page_b.text: Our parental leave policy provides 26 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers.

page_a.title: Service Level Agreement
page_a.text: We guarantee 99.9% monthly uptime for the core platform.

page_b.title: Enterprise SLA Terms
page_b.text: The core platform SLA is 99.5% monthly uptime; credits apply below that threshold.

page_a.title: Support Tiers
page_a.text: P1 incidents receive a first response within 15 minutes, 24/7.

page_b.title: Incident Response Handbook
page_b.text: The first-response target for P1 incidents is 1 hour during business hours only.

page_a.title: Backup Policy
page_a.text: Database backups are taken every 6 hours and retained for 30 days.

page_b.title: Disaster Recovery Plan
page_b.text: Backups run once daily at midnight UTC and are retained for 7 days.

page_a.title: Release Process
page_a.text: Production deployments happen every Tuesday and Thursday after QA sign-off.

page_b.title: Engineering Practices
page_b.text: We use continuous deployment: every merged PR deploys to production automatically.

page_a.title: Deployment Runbook
page_a.text: All services deploy via Jenkins pipelines defined in the deploy-jobs repository.

page_b.title: CI/CD Overview
page_b.text: Jenkins was decommissioned in March. All deployments now run through GitHub Actions workflows.

page_a.title: Environments
page_a.text: There are three environments: dev, staging, and production. Staging mirrors production data weekly.

page_b.title: Environment Guide
page_b.text: We maintain two environments only — dev and production. The staging environment was retired to cut costs.

page_a.title: Caching Architecture
page_a.text: All services use Redis for caching session and lookup data.

page_b.title: Platform Decisions Log
page_b.text: Decision: we are deprecating Redis for caching; all services must migrate to Memcached by end of quarter.

page_a.title: Cloud Strategy
page_a.text: All new workloads must be deployed to AWS. Azure is not an approved provider.

page_b.title: Infrastructure Standards
page_b.text: Azure is our primary cloud provider; AWS workloads are legacy and frozen.

page_a.title: Database Standards
page_a.text: PostgreSQL 14 is the standard database for all services.

page_b.title: Data Platform Guide
page_b.text: All services must run PostgreSQL 16; versions before 16 are out of support internally.

page_a.title: Password Policy
page_a.text: Passwords must be at least 8 characters and rotated every 90 days.

page_b.title: Security Baseline
page_b.text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters; mandatory rotation was abolished in favour of breach monitoring.

page_a.title: VPN Access
page_a.text: Access to internal systems requires the corporate VPN at all times.

page_b.title: Zero Trust Rollout
page_b.text: The corporate VPN has been retired. Internal systems are accessed via the zero-trust proxy with device certificates.

page_a.title: Data Retention
page_a.text: Customer PII is retained for 7 years to meet compliance obligations.

page_b.title: Privacy Policy Internal Guide
page_b.text: Customer PII must be deleted 12 months after account closure; longer retention is prohibited.

page_a.title: Pricing Overview
page_a.text: The Pro plan costs $49 per user per month, billed annually.

page_b.title: Sales Playbook
page_b.text: Pro plan pricing is $79 per user per month annual, effective from the January price update.

page_a.title: Free Tier Limits
page_a.text: The free tier includes 3 projects and 5 collaborators.

page_b.title: Plans Comparison
page_b.text: Free accounts are limited to 1 project and 2 collaborators.

page_a.title: Code Review Standards
page_a.text: Every PR requires two approving reviews before merge.

page_b.title: Team Working Agreement
page_b.text: PRs need a single approval to merge; the two-reviewer rule was dropped to reduce cycle time.

page_a.title: Incident Severity Definitions
page_a.text: A SEV1 is any incident with complete loss of service for all customers.

page_b.title: On-call Guide
page_b.text: SEV1 covers any customer-visible degradation, including partial outages affecting a single region.

page_a.title: Sprint Cadence
page_a.text: Teams run two-week sprints starting on Mondays.

page_b.title: Delivery Handbook
page_b.text: We moved to one-week sprints company-wide starting each Wednesday.

page_a.title: Service Catalog - Billing
page_a.text: The billing service is owned by the Payments team; page them for billing incidents.

page_b.title: Team Responsibilities
page_b.text: Billing is owned by the Revenue Platform team; the Payments team no longer maintains it.

page_a.title: Feature Flags Guide
page_a.text: Feature flags are managed in LaunchDarkly; the config repo flags.yaml is deprecated.

page_b.title: Runtime Configuration
page_b.text: All feature flags live in flags.yaml in the config repo. LaunchDarkly was evaluated and rejected.

page_a.title: Logging Standards
page_a.text: Services must log in plain text format for human readability.

page_b.title: Observability Requirements
page_b.text: All service logs must be structured JSON; plain-text logging is non-compliant.

page_a.title: Leave Policy
page_a.text: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of annual leave per year.

page_b.title: Time Off FAQ
page_b.text: You earn 20 annual leave days each year as a full-time employee, accrued progressively.

page_a.title: API Authentication
page_a.text: Authenticate by passing your API key in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

page_b.title: Quick Start
page_b.text: Include the header Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key> on every request to authenticate.

page_a.title: Backup Schedule
page_a.text: Backups run nightly at 02:00 UTC and are kept for 30 days.

page_b.title: Data Protection Overview
page_b.text: We take a backup every night (2am UTC) with a 30-day retention window.

page_a.title: Code Review Standards
page_a.text: Every pull request must be approved by two reviewers before merging.

page_b.title: Engineering Onboarding
page_b.text: Remember that merges require two approving code reviews on the PR.

page_a.title: SLA Summary
page_a.text: The platform SLA guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime.

page_b.title: Customer Commitments
page_b.text: We commit to three nines (99.9%) of availability measured monthly.

page_a.title: Payments API - Charges
page_a.text: Use POST /api/v2/charges to create a charge. Amounts are in minor units.

page_b.title: Payments API - Refunds
page_b.text: Use POST /api/v2/refunds to refund a charge. Refunds settle within 5 business days.

page_a.title: Onboarding Week 1
page_a.text: In week one, new engineers set up their laptop, accounts, and complete security training.

page_b.title: Onboarding Week 2
page_b.text: In week two, new engineers pair with a buddy and ship their first small change.

page_a.title: Postgres Tuning
page_a.text: Set shared_buffers to 25% of system memory for dedicated database hosts.

page_b.title: Postgres Backup Guide
page_b.text: Use pg_dump for logical backups and WAL archiving for point-in-time recovery.

page_a.title: Incident Roles
page_a.text: Every incident has an Incident Commander who coordinates the response.

page_b.title: Incident Communications
page_b.text: Status updates are posted to the #incidents channel every 30 minutes during an active incident.

page_a.title: Design System - Buttons
page_a.text: Primary buttons use the brand blue and are reserved for the main action on a screen.

page_b.title: Design System - Forms
page_b.text: Form fields use 8px vertical spacing and always show validation errors inline.

page_a.title: Office Parking
page_a.text: Parking spots in the office garage are first-come, first-served on levels 2 and 3.

page_b.title: Kubernetes Upgrade Notes
page_b.text: The cluster was upgraded to Kubernetes 1.29; check deprecated API usage before deploying.

page_a.title: Social Club Events
page_a.text: The social club runs trivia nights on the last Friday of each month.

page_b.title: Data Warehouse Schemas
page_b.text: Fact tables follow the fct_ prefix convention; dimensions use dim_.

page_a.title: Brand Voice Guidelines
page_a.text: Our brand voice is friendly, direct, and avoids jargon.

page_b.title: VPN Split Tunneling
page_b.text: Split tunneling is enabled for video conferencing traffic to reduce VPN load.

page_a.title: US Leave Policy
page_a.text: US employees receive 15 days of PTO per year.

page_b.title: Australia Leave Policy
page_b.text: Australian employees receive 20 days of annual leave per year, as required by law.

page_a.title: Enterprise Plan SLA
page_a.text: Enterprise customers get a 99.95% uptime SLA with financially backed credits.

page_b.title: Standard Plan SLA
page_b.text: Standard plan customers receive a 99.5% uptime target without service credits.

page_a.title: Mobile App Release Process
page_a.text: Mobile releases ship fortnightly due to app-store review lead times.

page_b.title: Web Release Process
page_b.text: The web app deploys continuously — every merged PR goes to production.

page_a.title: 2023 Roadmap (Archived)
page_a.text: ARCHIVED: In 2023 we plan to migrate from MySQL to PostgreSQL.

page_b.title: Database Standards
page_b.text: PostgreSQL is our standard database; the MySQL migration completed in 2023.

page_a.title: API Deprecation Schedule
page_a.text: The v1 API will be sunset on June 30, 2026. Migrate before that date.

page_b.title: Legacy API Support
page_b.text: The v1 API is fully supported with no sunset date planned; customers may remain on v1 indefinitely.

page_a.title: Data Residency
page_a.text: All customer data is stored exclusively in EU data centres (Frankfurt and Dublin).

page_b.title: Architecture Overview
page_b.text: Customer data is replicated across US-East and EU regions for latency and resilience.

page_a.title: Support Hours
page_a.text: Support is available 24/7 for all paid plans.

page_b.title: Contact Us (Internal)
page_b.text: Support operates weekdays 9am-5pm AEST; after-hours coverage exists only for Enterprise.

page_a.title: Rate Limit Defaults
page_a.text: The default rate limit is 100 requests per minute; customers can request an increase.

page_b.title: Enterprise Rate Limits
page_b.text: Enterprise keys are provisioned at 1,000 requests per minute by default.

page_a.title: Old Password Policy (superseded)
page_a.text: SUPERSEDED by Security Baseline v3: passwords rotate every 90 days.

page_b.title: Security Baseline v3
page_b.text: Passwords must be 14+ characters; rotation is no longer required.
